definitions.explanation: A state of being emotionally controlled and not affected by excitement, anger, or panic; level-headedness.

examples.japanese: {冷静|れいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}えてください→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.notes: {冷静|れいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ = calmly (adverbial form)

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{冷静|れいせい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きても→起きる：00521_okiru⟧、{冷静|れいせい}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Even when an accident happens, it's important to maintain composure.
examples.notes: {冷静|れいせい}さ = calmness (noun form with さ)

notes:
USAGE: {冷静|れいせい} describes the quality of staying calm and thinking clearly, especially in stressful situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{冷静|れいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to think calmly)
・{冷静|れいせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断：03571_handan⟧ (to judge calmly)
・{冷静|れいせい}さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧/⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to maintain/lose composure)
・{冷静|れいせい}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (calm judgment)

CONTRAST:
・{冷静|れいせい} - emotionally calm, cool-headed
・⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧ - physically quiet, peaceful
